title: Announcing Data Package v2 Support in Frictionless R and Python Libraries
content:
The Frictionless libraries for R and Python now support the Data Package v2 specification — with cross-language harmonisation, automatic version detection and continued v1 compatibility. Made possible by the NLnet Foundation, all the maintainers and broader Frictionless Data community.

The post Announcing Data Package v2 Support in Frictionless R and Python Libraries first appeared on Open Knowledge Blog.
